newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iran sends envoy to President Saddam Hussein - INA.
newsitem.headline: Iran sends envoy to President Saddam Hussein - INA.

text.p: Iran has dispatched a special envoy to Iraqi President Saddam Hussein, the Iraqi News Agency (INA) reported on Thursday.
It said Health Minister Ali Ridha Mirandi, who is also the personal envoy of Iranian President Ali Hashemi Rafsanjani to Saddam, arrived in Baghdad at noon today.
It said Marandi's visit would last several days but gave no details .
Iraq and Iran, old enemies who fought the 1980-88 Iraq-Iran War, are locked on a set of issues which hinder normal ties between them such as prisoners of war.
